test_nest_flatten: test nest.flatten to recursively flatten nested tuples, lists, and dicts into a flat list
test_nest_map: test nest.map to apply a lambda function to all leaf values in a nested structure
test_nest_pack_as: test nest.pack_as to reconstruct a nested structure from a flat list matching the original shape
test_nest_map_many2: test nest.map_many2 to apply a two-argument function to corresponding leaves of two nested structures
test_nest_front: test nest.front to retrieve the first leaf value from a nested tuple or list structure
